US President Donald Trump criticizes China's potential takeover of the Panama Canal

Former US President Donald Trump has expressed disapproval over the US handover of the Panama Canal, citing increased fees and alleged Chinese influence. He vowed to prevent Beijing's takeover and reiterated his stance on birthright citizenship. The comments come as the US and China engage in a trade war.
